title: Surfaces and diagrams
blurb: Forms, dashboards, diagrams and charts, drawn by tuios.

greet: Forms, charts and diagrams, right in your panes. Let us draw some.
Hi. Today your shell asks you a question in a real form.
finish: A form, a flowchart, a chart and a dashboard. Nice work.

steps.title: Read the markup
steps.note: TML is the markup tuios draws forms and dashboards from. A file is a tree of parts with a JSON state.
steps.hint: Type cat deploy.tml and press enter.

steps.title: Draw it as text
steps.note: tuios tml render shows the file the way a pane draws it.
steps.hint: Type tuios tml render deploy.tml and press enter.

steps.title: Open the form
steps.note: A surface is a TML file that tuios shows live, in a popup or a pane. With --wait, the command waits for your answer.
steps.hint: Type tuios tml show deploy.tml --wait and press enter.

steps.title: Move to the form
steps.note: The keyboard focus stays on your shell. ctrl+b 2 moves the focus to the form. A click works too.
steps.hint: Press ctrl+b, then 2. Or click the form.

steps.title: Deploy to production
steps.note: down and enter pick production. tab goes to Deploy. enter sends the answer to the shell.
steps.hint: Press down, enter, tab, enter. The answer prints in the shell.

steps.title: Draw the deploy flow
steps.note: tuios mermaid draws a Mermaid diagram as text that fits the pane.
steps.hint: Type tuios mermaid flow.mmd and press enter.

steps.title: Chart the sales
steps.note: tplot reads CSV and draws it in your theme's colours.
steps.hint: Type tplot sales.csv --kind bar and press enter.

steps.title: Open a dashboard pane
steps.note: A table, a chart and a diagram in one surface. --pane tiles it beside your shell.
steps.hint: Type tuios tml show status.tml --pane and press enter.

steps.title: Float the dashboard
steps.note: ctrl+b right moves to it. ctrl+b t f floats it. Press ctrl+b t f again to put it back in the tiles.
steps.hint: Press ctrl+b, then right. Then ctrl+b, t, f.
